title: Customizing the Admin Interface
description: Use `ModelAdmin` to control list views, search, filters, and more.

slides.title: List View Options 📋
slides.content:
The `ModelAdmin` class offers many attributes to tweak the changelist (list) view.

- **`list_display`** – which fields to show as columns.
- **`list_display_links`** – which columns link to the edit page (default first).
- **`list_filter`** – add filters in the sidebar.
- **`search_fields`** – enable searching on specified fields.
- **`ordering`** – default ordering of the list.
- **`list_per_page`** – pagination.

slides.title: Example Customization
slides.content:
@admin.register(Post)
class PostAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ('title', 'author', 'published_date', 'is_published')
    list_filter = ('is_published', 'author')
    search_fields = ('title', 'content', 'author__username')
    ordering = ('-published_date',)
    list_per_page = 25

    # Show custom method in list_display
    def is_published(self, obj):
        return obj.published_date is not None
    is_published.boolean = True  # display as icon

quizData.question: Which attribute of ModelAdmin controls which columns appear in the list view?
quizData.explanation: `list_display` is a tuple of field names to display in the changelist.

slides.title: Edit Form Customization ✏️
slides.content:
You can also customize the add/change forms:

- **`fields`** – which fields to show and in what order.
- **`exclude`** – fields to omit.
- **`fieldsets`** – group fields into sections.
- **`readonly_fields`** – fields that are not editable.
- **`prepopulated_fields`** – automatically fill a slug field from another field.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use `readonly_fields` to prevent editing of auto‑populated fields

For example, if you have a `created_at` field set automatically, add it to `readonly_fields` so users cannot modify it.
